paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: you can't earn your way to God, and you don't have to. Paul says all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God (Romans 3:23), and that includes every baker, every chef's hat, and every stamper on a gold base. But the righteousness of God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe (Romans 3:22). It's a gift, and Paul says we are justified "freely by His grace" (Romans 3:24).

So why does this matter to you? Because it takes the scoreboard right out of your hands. Paul asks, "Where, then, is boasting?" and answers, "It is excluded" (Romans 3:27). That means no bragging about a perfect batch, and no hiding in shame over a burnt one, because the thing holding you up was never your cookies. It was Jesus, whom God presented as an atoning sacrifice (Romans 3:25).

And it's for EVERYBODY. There is only one God, and He justifies the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith (Romans 3:30). Paul also says this faith doesn't toss the law aside. Instead, "we uphold the law" (Romans 3:31). So lean on Jesus, baker, set down the scoreboard, and let the gift be a gift.
